text: Something, something elegant design... something, something cutting-edge technology. For nearly 25 years, we've been too busy designing and building websites and custom applications to put the proper time and attention into our own damn website. That's not an excuse, that's a point of pride.
ticker: We were going to put an image on this page.
It was going to be really nice, I swear.
But we never got around to it.
We couldn't decide if it should be puppies with kittens or robots with lasers.
Then we thought maybe it should be puppies with lasers.
Or kittens with robots?
We couldn't decide.
So this is what we ended up with.
Kind of disappointing, right?.
Well, it is what it is.
Not to ruin the surprise, but nothing special happens if you keep clicking this button.
Seriously.
Not a thing.
Nada.
Nothing.
Zip.
Zero.
Zilch.
Although...
At some point it will probably explode.
Just kidding.
It is not going to explode.
Probably.
At some point it will probably just loop back to the beginning.
So, you should probably just go back to work.
But, that doesn't sound very appealing does it?
At least you won't be stuck here clicking this button anymore.
Seriously, you should go for a walk.
Touch some grass or something.
Maybe take an early lunch.
Maybe pay attention to that Zoom call you're on.
You must have SOMETHING better to do.
A TPS report or something?
BTW, remember when most of the internet was like this?
Little silly surprises... people who were in it for a laugh more than a buck?
That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
Sigh...
The internet is just kind of terrible today isn't it?
I mean, it doesn't have to be, but it is.
And it isn't getting better any time soon, what with AI everything, all the time.
It is something to think about.
Especially if you are in charge of a website, which, unfortunately for both of us, I am.
The way I see it there are two paths:
You can design a generic corporate looking website.
Fill it with bland AI generated copy and some AI generated stock photos.
Cram it to the brim with invasive third party tracking scripts.
Maybe throw in some press clippings for the investors.
And call it a day.
OR... and this might sound crazy...
You could actually try to make something that is both beautiful and functional.
Or, at least, useful for your clients
Maybe something that makes sense and answers some real questions.
Maybe even tells a story that is interesting.
Just saying. It's worth a thought.
I see lots of companies wasting their time on social media.
Let me tell you, no one in all of social media cares about interacting with your company unless it is to complain.
Other companies blow a lot of budget on videos that metrics prove no one will ever watch.
Sometimes all of the money goes to digital ads.
And the grim truth is, they mostly don't work.
Unless your goal is to spend an insane amount of money very quickly.
And you're not even sure if it's working, because you're not sure what you're measuring.
I mean, all of that is very easy to do, and you won't stand out if you do it.
But, maybe there is a better way.
I'm not saying an easier way, mind you.
But a better way.
To carefully design, build, and manage your marketing websites, web tools, and web applications.
So they work.
They look nice.
They are easy to use and don't drive your customers bonkers.
Maybe they even say real things in plain language.
Maybe they include tools that solve real problems for you, your partners, or your customers.
Maybe users keeping coming back.
Not because you chase them with digital ads all over the internet.
But because you respect your users, and you are providing something of real value.
Or you made them smile.
Or you made them click {{count}} times on one single button
And they didn't hate it.
